title: myflames statement latency histogram (digest-histogram-1.0)
description: The latency histogram of one statement digest (myflames/discover.py digest_histogram, /api/live/digest-histogram): the buckets of performance_schema.events_statements_histogram_by_digest that hold at least one call, for one SCHEMA_NAME (null matches a digest recorded without a default schema) and one DIGEST, in bucket order. MySQL keeps 450 buckets per digest: bucket 0 below 10 microseconds, then bounds growing by a factor of 10^(1/50), the last one open-ended. Counts are cumulative since the digest was first seen. MariaDB keeps no histogram: available is false with a reason. Read-only.

schema.description: The digest's default schema, or null for a digest recorded without one.

digest.description: The full digest in lowercase hexadecimal.

available.description: False on MariaDB or on a MySQL server without the histogram table; the workspace then omits the histogram.

reason.description: Why no histogram is available, or null.

high_ms.description: BUCKET_TIMER_HIGH in milliseconds, or null for the open-ended last bucket.

count.description: COUNT_BUCKET: calls whose time fell in this bucket (always above zero here).
